name: FAIR Metric - A2 - Metadata - Database declares preservation policy
description: This FAIRsharing record describes: **What is being measured?** This metric evaluates whether the database declares a preservation policy. In FAIRsharing, this corresponds to a non-empty Preservation Policy URL. Expected input is the DOI or URL of the registry (e.g. FAIRsharing) record under evaluation. **Why should we measure it?** A2 requires that metadata remain accessible even when the data are no longer available. Information describing a database's preservation commitments helps users and assessment services understand how the database intends to preserve its records over time. The presence of a Preservation Policy URL does not imply that the underlying policy is adequate, implemented or effective. It demonstrates only that preservation information has been provided. This metric has similarities with FAIR Metric - A2 - Metadata - Database persistence policy, which also evaluates declared preservation commitments at the database level. Whereas that metric begins with a research object identifier and uses FAIRsharing as a source of evidence about the hosting database, this metric begins with a registry record identifier as part of an evaluation of the database itself.
